subject.title: Require explicit Keychain interaction for Chromium cookies

question: Should SweetCookieKit adopt `BrowserCookieKeychainAccessGate.withUserInteractionDisallowed` as a permanent public host API?
rationale: The patch adds a new public interaction-policy contract; code review can validate mechanics but cannot determine the repository owner's intended API surface.

options.title: Adopt the scoped policy
options.body: Keep the public TaskLocal API after correcting alias fallback and obtaining live macOS proof for both behavior modes.

options.title: Keep policy internal
options.body: Use an internal importer option until a different public interaction-policy design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped policy
recommendation.body: Keep the public TaskLocal API after correcting alias fallback and obtaining live macOS proof for both behavior modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner committed and released the current Safe Storage behavior and is the clearest owner of the public package contract.
